# Unmodified JLaTeXMath-Android 0.2.0 sources

`jlatexmath-android-0.2.0-sources.jar` is the exact Maven Central source artifact.
`jlatexmath-android-0.2.0-resources.zip` contains the unmodified assets and resources
from the corresponding published AAR (including font files and font metadata).
Gradle resolves the published AAR for the application build; these archives are
provided with the Luma source distribution and are not packaged as application assets.

Upstream build project: https://github.com/noties/jlatexmath-android
Artifact directory: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/ru/noties/jlatexmath-android/0.2.0/
License, notices and independent-module linking exception are in
`app/src/main/assets/licenses/` and the original source headers.
